_about: Systems the plans' keynotes build (keynotes.rs, the guided job's keynote step): a system's names as notes and schedules write them, and the parts of it the job must find in the documents before it builds or prices them. A part no document places stays `undecided`, with why; it is never guessed.

systems.name: BDA
systems.title: emergency responder radio coverage (BDA)
systems.source: IFC 510 and NFPA 1221 (emergency responder radio coverage): a head-end (bi-directional amplifier, on a dedicated circuit with standby power), a donor antenna outside (usually the roof) and the coverage antennas inside
